blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LiDAR provides precise geometric information for spatial perception tasks such as object detection in autonomous driving and outdoor robotics. However, recognizing and localizing individual objects is not sufficient to answer questions that require composing spatial relations and grounding the intended target. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for autonomous driving, we leverage their language priors to interpret complex spatial questions and ground the referred target in LiDAR geometry. To support this spatial grounding capability, we introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA, which combines single- and multi-step relational grounding with complementary spatial understanding tasks. We further propose SpatialLiDAR-LM, which aligns LiDAR point features with an LLM and grounds target coordinates through language-conditioned, position-aware proposal retrieval and local point refinement. This design derives target coordinates directly from local LiDAR geometry rather than through textual language decoding. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over representative LiDAR–language models and multi-camera VLMs on precise coordinate prediction tasks. Our dataset and model training code will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: LiDAR为空间感知任务提供精确的几何信息,如自主驾驶和室外机器人中的物体探测. 然而,单个物体的识别和定位不足以回答需要形成空间关系和使预定目标搁浅的问题。 受最近大语言模型(LLMs)自主驱动的进步的推动,我们利用他们的语言前身来解释复杂的空间问题,并将LiDAR几何学中提及的目标进行地面定位. 为了支持这种空间定位能力,我们引入了SpaceLiDAR-QA,将单步和多步的关系定位与互补的空间理解任务结合起来. 我们进一步提出SpaceLiDAR-LM,通过语言条件、位置感知建议检索和局部点改进,将LiDAR点特征与LLM和地面目标坐标相协调。 这种设计直接从本地的LiDAR几何中获取目标坐标,而不是通过文字语言解码. 实验显示,在精确坐标预测任务方面,比有代表性的LiDAR语言模型和多相机VLM有重大改进。 我们的数据集和模型训练代码将公开发布.

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1: LiDAR provides precise geometry for object detection, but spatial questions require more than localizing individual objects: relations must be composed to ground the intended target.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1:LiDAR为物体探测提供了精确的几何学,但空间问题需要的不仅仅是单个物体的定位:关系必须组成,才能使预定目标搁浅.

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal learning have enabled language-based understanding across diverse modalities, including images [ 1 , 2 ] , speech and audio [ 3 ] , point clouds [ 4 , 5 ] , and radar [ 6 ] . These developments have encouraged the use of large language models (LLMs) in autonomous driving, connecting sensor observations with question answering, reasoning, and decision-making [ 7 , 8 ] . In driving and outdoor robotics environments, such capabilities require understanding not only what objects are present, but also where they are and how they are spatially related.
blocks.zh: 最近在多模式学习方面取得的进展使得能够以语言为基础理解各种模式,包括图像[1、2]、语音和音频[3]、点云[4、5]和雷达[6]。 这些发展鼓励在自主驾驶中使用大型语言模型,将传感器观测与回答问题、推理和决策联系起来[7、8]。 在驾驶和室外机器人环境方面,这种能力不仅需要了解哪些物体存在,而且需要了解它们的位置和它们是如何在空间上相互联系的。

blocks.en: Within this broader research direction, LiDAR–language models have established capabilities in object detection, captioning, and question answering [ 9 , 10 ] . Building on these advances, we focus on spatial grounding: questions that couple relational reasoning with precise localization. For example, a question may ask for the object in front of another object that is itself to the left of a specified reference. Answering it requires identifying the reference, following the first relation to an intermediate object, and resolving the second relation to the final target. Predicting the target’s class and coordinates then requires connecting this relational interpretation to the observed geometry. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , this motivates tasks that jointly require reference identification, relation composition, and precise coordinate prediction, rather than evaluating object recognition or location prediction in isolation.
blocks.zh: 在这一更广泛的研究方向内,LiDAR语言模型在物体探测、标题和问答[9、10]方面建立了能力。 在这些进展的基础上,我们侧重于空间地面:将推理与精确本地化结合起来的问题。 例如,一个问题可能会在指定引用左侧的另一对象前询问对象. 回答它需要识别参考,在第一个与中间对象的关系之后,解决第二个与最终目标的关系. 预测目标类别和坐标则需要将这种关系解释与观测到的几何学联系起来。 如图1所示,这激发了共同需要参考识别、关系构成和精确坐标预测而不是孤立地评价物体识别或位置预测的任务。

blocks.en: Constructing such tasks requires spatial relations that are clearly specified and supervision that connects their interpretation to target locations. Existing datasets provide relational understanding, object detection, and geometry-based spatial evaluation [ 11 , 9 , 12 ] . In particular, some relational QA formulations represent object-to-object directions through six angular sectors referenced to the ego vehicle’s forward axis [ 11 ] . These sectors support relational questions but describe broad spatial regions with limited metric specificity. Their boundaries can also make directional labels sensitive to small changes in relative position. When multiple objects satisfy the same directional relation, the relation label alone may not uniquely identify the intended referent. Categorical relational answers alone do not verify whether the target is precisely localized, while object detection alone fails to test whether the target is identified through relational reasoning. Supervision that systematically connects these capabilities for both training and evaluation remains limited. These gaps motivate a dataset that combines clearly defined relations with single- and multi-step relational grounding requiring precise coordinate predictions, together with complementary spatial understanding tasks to address these challenges.
blocks.zh: 构建这些任务需要明确指定的空间关系,需要监督,将解释与目标地点联系起来。 现有数据集提供关系理解,对象检测,以及基于几何的空间评价[11,9,12]. 特别是,一些关系性QA配方通过6个角扇区代表物体对物体的方向,这些角扇区参照了自我飞行器的前进轴[11]。 这些部门支持关系问题,但描述的空间面积大,具体度有限。 它们的边界还可以使方向标签对相对位置的小变化敏感. 当多个对象满足相同的方向关系时,仅关系标签可能无法唯一地识别预期的引用者. 分类关系解答单是无法验证目标是否准确本地化,而单是对象检测无法验证目标是否通过关系推理被识别. 系统地将这些能力连接起来进行培训和评价的监督仍然有限。 这些差距促使建立一个数据集,将明确界定的关系与需要精确协调预测的单步和多步关系地面结合起来,同时开展互补的空间理解任务,以应对这些挑战。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA , a LiDAR-native dataset of 108,811 QA pairs constructed from nuScenes keyframes [ 13 ] . We define direct directional relations from relative object-center coordinates, with the specified reference object determining the relational origin and the ego vehicle defining fixed directional axes. The generation process filters out directionally ambiguous cases and composes valid relations into single- and multi-step relational grounding questions that require predicting the final target’s class and LiDAR-frame coordinates. Complementary Localization and Object Identification tasks assess object-to-coordinate and coordinate-to-class correspondence, while maneuver feasibility evaluates the use of surrounding geometry for ego-centric decisions. Together, these tasks provide spatial grounding supervision, but a model must still distinguish the referred instance from similar candidates and recover its coordinates from the supporting LiDAR geometry. Existing LiDAR–language models demonstrate that aligned scene features can support spatial grounding. Nevertheless, decoding location tokens from these representations does not explicitly derive the predicted coordinates from the points supporting the selected target [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了SpaceLiDAR-QA,一个由nuScenes keyframes[13]构建的由108,811对QA组成的LiDAR本地数据集. 我们从相对对象-中心坐标定义直接方向关系,指定参考对象确定关系源,自负载体确定固定方向轴. 生成过程过滤出方向模糊的病例,并将有效关系构成单步和多步关系地面问题,需要预测最终目标类别和LiDAR-帧坐标。 补充的局部化和对象识别任务评估对象对协调和协调对类的通信,而操纵可行性则评估周围几何学用于自我中心决定的情况。 这些任务加在一起提供了空间定位监督,但一个模型仍然必须区分被引用实例和类似的候选实例,并从支持的LiDAR几何中恢复其坐标. 现有的LiDAR语言模型表明,对齐的场景特征可以支持空间地面. 尽管如此,从这些表示符中解码位置符号并没有从支持选定目标的点中明确得出预测坐标[9].

blocks.en: We therefore propose SpatialLiDAR-LM , an end-to-end architecture that aligns point features with an LLM. Its Point-Retrieved Localization (PRL) module uses the LLM’s contextual language representation to retrieve question-relevant spatial proposals and refine the target coordinate from their supporting local points. Proposal-Key Positional Encoding incorporates proposal locations into retrieval, helping distinguish similar instances according to the spatial conditions expressed in the question. This design connects language-conditioned target selection with explicit spatial geometry, enabling the model to use LiDAR’s spatial information when answering spatial grounding questions.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提出SpaceLiDAR-LM,一种将点特征与LLM相配合的端到端架构. 其Point-Retrieved Localization(PRL)模块使用LLM的上下文语言表述来检索与问题相关的空间建议,并从支持它们的地方点完善目标坐标. 提议要点 编码将建议位置纳入检索,帮助根据问题中表达的空间条件区分类似情况。 这种设计将语言条件化的目标选择与明确的空间几何连接起来,使模型在回答空间定位问题时能够使用LiDAR的空间信息.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA , which couples explicitly defined spatial relations with single- and multi-step relational grounding and complementary spatial understanding tasks, supporting both training and evaluation of LiDAR–language spatial grounding. • We propose SpatialLiDAR-LM , which connects contextual language representations to language-conditioned, position-aware proposal retrieval and local point refinement, deriving target coordinates from question-relevant LiDAR geometry. • We evaluate SpatialLiDAR-LM on SpatialLiDAR-QA and demonstrate substantial improvements over representative LiDAR–language and multi-camera models on precise coordinate prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:我们引入了SpaceLiDAR-QA,夫妇们明确界定了与单步和多步关系地面和互补空间理解任务的空间关系,支持对LiDAR-语言空间地面的培训和评估。 • 支助 我们提出SpaceLiDAR-LM,将背景语言表述与语言条件化、位置感知的建议检索和局部点改进联系起来,从与问题相关的LiDAR几何中得出目标坐标。 我们评价SpaceLiDAR-LM的SpaceLiDAR-QA,并显示比具有代表性的LiDAR语言模型和多相机模型在精确坐标预测方面的重大改进。

blocks.en: II RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A LiDAR-Based MLLMs for Outdoor Scene Understanding
blocks.zh: II-A LiDAR 用于室外场景理解的 MLLMs

blocks.en: Recent LiDAR-based MLLMs have extended language understanding to outdoor point-cloud scenes. BEV-LLM [ 14 ] combines LiDAR and multi-view image features in a unified BEV representation for scene captioning and uses absolute positional encoding to generate view-specific descriptions. LiDAR-LLM [ 9 ] supports captioning, question answering, and 3D grounding by aligning detector-pretrained BEV features with an LLM. Its Position-Aware Transformer divides BEV features into six camera-aligned views and injects the corresponding positional embeddings into the features and queries, and its grounding task generates location tokens specifying 3D boxes. B4DL [ 10 ] extends LiDAR–language modeling to sequential frames for spatio-temporal tasks, including temporal reasoning and time grounding, using aligned frame-wise features and ego-motion metatokens.
blocks.zh: 最近基于LiDAR的MLLMs将语言理解扩展到户外点云场景. BEV-LLM [14] 将LiDAR和多视图图像功能结合在一个统一的BEV代表符中,用于场景字幕,并使用绝对位置编码生成特定视图描述. LiDAR-LLM [9] 支持字幕,提问回答,和3D地面定位,将探测器预先训练的BEV特性与LLM对齐. 它的定位-智能变形器将BEV特性分为6个相机对齐的视图,并将相应的定位嵌入到特性和查询中,其定位任务生成指定3D框的位置符. B4DL [10] 将 LiDAR - 语言模型扩展为时空任务的顺序框架,包括时间推理和时间定位,使用对齐的帧式特征和自我运动元数据.

blocks.en: Building on these advances, our model connects relational spatial reasoning with precise coordinate estimation from LiDAR geometry.
blocks.zh: 在这些进步的基础上,我们的模型将关系空间推理与来自LiDAR几何的精确坐标估计联系起来.

blocks.en: II-B Spatial Reasoning Datasets for Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: II-B 自主驾驶空间理性数据集

blocks.en: Existing autonomous-driving QA datasets provide useful supervision for scene understanding, but differ in how spatial relations are represented and evaluated. NuScenes-QA [ 11 ] constructs 3D scene graphs with object-to-object relations defined by six angular categories relative to the ego vehicle’s forward axis. Although this supports relational questions, each category describes a broad spatial sector, and its existence, counting, recognition, status, and comparison tasks produce categorical answers rather than precise target coordinates. Its formulation therefore evaluates relational QA without directly requiring precise localization of the referred object. LiDAR-LLM [ 9 ] provides captioning and 3D grounding supervision, but its captioning tasks are generated from camera images using 2D MLLMs and GPT-4 filtering, and its tasks do not systematically combine precise localization with compositional object-relative reasoning. NuScenes-SpatialQA [ 12 ] uses ground-truth 3D geometry to construct spatial understanding and reasoning questions. However, its object references are derived from camera-image captions, and it is designed for image-based VLM evaluation rather than providing training supervision for LiDAR–language alignment. To complement these benchmarks, SpatialLiDAR-QA supports both training and evaluation on tasks requiring spatial reasoning, such as single- and multi-step relational grounding with precise coordinate prediction.
blocks.zh: 现有的自主驾驶QA数据集为场景理解提供了有益的监督,但在空间关系如何表现和评估上却有所不同. NuScenes-QA [11] 构造3D场景图,其对象对对象关系由6个角类相对自负飞行器的前轴定义. 虽然这支持关系问题,但每个类别都描述了一个广阔的空间部门,其存在,计数,识别,地位,比较任务产生绝对的答案而不是精确的目标坐标. 因此,它的表述评价了关系性质量评估,而并不直接要求将所指物体准确定位。 LiDAR-LLM [9] 提供字幕和3D定位监管,但其字幕任务来自使用2D MLLM和GPT-4过滤的相机图像,其任务并没有系统地将精确本地化与组成对象-相对推理相结合. NuScens-SpacealQA [12] 使用地面真实的3D几何来构建空间理解和推理问题. 然而,其对象引用来源于相机-图像字幕,其设计基于图像的VLM评价,而不是为LiDAR-语言对齐提供培训监督. 为了补充这些基准,SpaceLiDAR-QA支持对需要空间推理的任务进行培训和评价,例如用精确的坐标预测进行单步和多步关系定位。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , SpatialLiDAR-QA defines five complementary tasks for training and evaluation.

blocks.en: III-A Dataset Details
blocks.zh: 三-A 数据集细节

blocks.en: 1. Direct Localization: Given an object category, the model predicts the LiDAR-frame center coordinates of the instance closest to the ego vehicle, testing distance-based instance selection and precise localization.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 直接本地化 : 鉴于一个对象类别,该模型预测最接近自负载体的实例的LiDAR-帧中心坐标,测试基于距离的实例选择和精确本地化.

blocks.en: 2. Object Identification: Given a LiDAR-frame coordinate ( x , y ) (x,y) , the model predicts the object class at that location, testing spatial-to-semantic correspondence.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 对象识别:鉴于LiDAR-帧坐标(x,y) (x,y),模型预测该位置的物体类,测试空间对语义的对应.

blocks.en: 3. Single-Step Relational Grounding: Given a reference object and a directional relation along the ego-aligned axes, the model predicts the target’s class and LiDAR-frame coordinates. Partially occluded targets are also included, subject to the criteria in Sec. III-B .
blocks.zh: 3个 单步关系 定位: 鉴于一个参考对象和自相配合轴的方向关系,该模型预测目标类别和LiDAR-帧坐标。 部分未达到的目标也包括在内,但须符合第III-B节的标准。

blocks.en: 4. Multi-Step Relational Grounding: The model composes two directional relations through an intermediate object to predict the final target’s class and LiDAR-frame coordinates, keeping the ego-aligned axes fixed.
blocks.zh: 4. 多步骤关系 定位: 该模型通过中间物体组成两个方向关系,以预测最终目标等级和LiDAR-帧坐标,保持自定轴的固定.

blocks.en: 5. Maneuver Feasibility: Given the surrounding object configuration, the model judges whether continuing straight or changing lanes to either side is geometrically feasible, testing ego-centric free-space reasoning.
blocks.zh: 5.五. 操作可行性: 考虑到周围的物体配置,模型判断是继续直行还是改变向两侧的车道都是几何上可行的,测试以自我为中心的自由空间推理.

blocks.en: III-B Dataset Construction Process
blocks.zh: 三-B 数据集建设过程

blocks.en: SpatialLiDAR-QA is generated on official nuScenes keyframes [ 13 ] using geometry-verified rules across eight object categories ( car, truck, bus, trailer, construction_vehicle, pedestrian, bicycle, motorcycle ). Strict filtering removes ambiguous directional cases, while maneuver-feasibility labels are balanced to avoid skewed answer distributions. Specifically, following the difficulty criteria of the Waymo Open Dataset [ 15 ] , objects containing fewer than 5 LiDAR points are filtered out to eliminate heavily occluded or unidentifiable instances.
blocks.zh: SpaceLiDAR-QA是在官方nuScens键框[13]上产生的,使用经过几何验证的规则,跨越8个物体类别(汽车、卡车、公共汽车、拖车、建筑_车辆、行人、自行车、摩托车)。 严格的过滤可以消除模糊的方向性大小写,而操纵可行性标签是平衡的,以避免扭曲的答案分布. 具体地说,按照Waymo Open Dataset [15] 的难度标准,含有少于5个LiDAR点的对象会被过滤出去,以消除严重占有或无法识别的例.

blocks.en: We express ground-truth object centers in a BEV frame centered at the LiDAR sensor, with ego-aligned axes such that + x +x points right and + y +y forward. Accordingly, front , back , right , and left correspond to + y +y , − y -y , + x +x , and − x -x , respectively. Relative displacements are measured from the reference object along these fixed axes rather than its heading, maintaining a consistent directional convention across reference changes in multi-step questions. A directional relation is accepted only when the displacement along the corresponding axis is at least three times the perpendicular displacement magnitude. Thus, diagonal cases remain undefined rather than being assigned a directional label.
blocks.zh: 我们用以LiDAR传感器为核心的BEV框架来表达地面真实物体中心,其自成一体的轴线可以使+x+x的点数正确,+y+y向前。 因此,前,后,右,左分别对应+y +y,−y-y,+x +x,和−x-x. 从这些固定轴的参考对象而不是其标题来衡量相对转移情况,在多步骤问题的参考变化中保持一致的方向公约。 只有沿相应轴线的流离失所至少是垂直流离失所规模的三倍,才接受方向关系。 因此,对角案件仍然没有定义,而不是被赋予方向标签。

blocks.en: IV-B Point-Retrieved Localization
blocks.zh: 四-B 点检索本地化

blocks.en: Several localization-oriented MLLMs formulate coordinate prediction as sequential token generation, representing locations with textual numbers or discrete location tokens [ 18 , 19 ] . LiDAR-LLM also supports location-token-based grounding [ 9 ] . Our contribution is not the introduction of a localization token, but how the localization-token representation is connected to the observed geometry. Rather than using this representation solely to decode coordinates, Point-Retrieved Localization (PRL) uses it to retrieve a question-relevant spatial proposal and derives the final coordinate from the local points supporting that proposal. This provides an explicit geometric readout through proposal retrieval and local point refinement.
blocks.zh: 一些面向本地化的 MLLMs 将坐标预测作为顺序符号生成,代表有文字数字或离散位置符号的位置 [18, 19]. LiDAR-LLM也支持基于位置的按键地面[9]. 我们的贡献不是引入一个本地化符号,而是本地化-音标的表示方式如何与观测到的几何相连接. Point-Retrieved Localization(PRL)不是仅仅利用这种表示来解码坐标,而是利用它来检索与问题相关的空间建议,并从支持该建议的地方点获得最终坐标. 这通过建议检索和本地点的完善,提供了明确的几何读取.

blocks.en: Spatial Ambiguity. Proposal features describe the local geometry around each candidate, but they may not sufficiently distinguish multiple instances with similar structure. This is common in driving scenes containing several vehicles or pedestrians, where semantic similarity alone can lead the query to retrieve the wrong instance. The issue becomes more pronounced for relational questions, which require the model to distinguish candidates using both their semantic content and their LiDAR-frame position.

Class prediction tasks and Maneuver Feasibility. Table IV evaluates categorical text outputs: Object Identification, the class predictions of Single- and Multi-Step Relational Grounding, and Maneuver Feasibility. The VLMs generally achieve the highest accuracy on these tasks, consistent with the richer semantic and contextual cues available in images. For example, with Qwen3.5, the multi-camera VLM achieves 92.2% on Maneuver Feasibility, compared with 85.5% for SpatialLiDAR-LM. Nevertheless, SpatialLiDAR-LM achieves higher or competitive performance compared with the other LiDAR-based baselines on most tasks. In particular, on Maneuver Feasibility, it reaches 87.2% with SmolVLM and 85.5% with Qwen3.5, substantially outperforming the LiDAR-based BEV-LLM and LiDAR-LLM baselines.
SpatialLiDAR-LM is also competitive with the multi-camera VLM on selected
semantic tasks. With SmolVLM, it achieves 71.8% on Multi-Step class
prediction, compared with 71.5% for the VLM; with Qwen3.5, it reaches
73.0% on Object Identification, compared with 77.1% for the VLM.
These results indicate that the proposed LiDAR–language architecture
supports semantic recognition alongside precise coordinate grounding.

blocks.en: VI CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 六、结 论

blocks.en:
In this work, we advance LiDAR–language understanding by connecting
language-based spatial reasoning with the metric geometry of outdoor
scenes. We introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA to support training and evaluation
on tasks that require identifying objects, following or composing spatial
relations, and grounding the intended target. SpatialLiDAR-LM addresses
these tasks through language-conditioned retrieval and local point-based
coordinate prediction, linking the LLM’s interpretation of a question
to the observed LiDAR geometry. Experiments and ablation studies support the proposed design for precise
localization and relational grounding. Competitive performance on selected
semantic tasks and zero-shot cross-dataset results further suggest that
this approach can support broader LiDAR–language understanding.
Together, SpatialLiDAR-QA and SpatialLiDAR-LM provide a foundation for
developing geometrically grounded language models that integrate semantic
recognition, spatial reasoning, and precise localization. We will publicly
release the dataset and training code to support further research toward
language-guided spatial understanding in autonomous driving and outdoor
robotics.
